ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Global Navigation Satellite Systems. Prerequisites: ECE 329. An introduction to global navigation satellite systems, with a focus on the global positioning system (GPS). Other systems, such as the European Galileo system and the Russian GLONASS system, will also be discussed. This course uses GPS as a case study for performing an end-to-end analysis of a complex engineering system. Topics to be covered in lectures and laboratories include basics of navigation, mathematics of obtaining a navigation solution, receiver design and analysis, error analysis and error mitigation. Laboratories will focus on understanding receiver design and developing a Matlab-based GPS receiver.
